```yaml
name: Mobile Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: sure_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Setup database
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_test
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/1
        run: |
          bin/rails db:create
          bin/rails db:schema:load

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_test
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/1
        run: |
          bin/rails test

      - name: Run Rubocop
        run: |
          bundle exec rubocop

  build:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Build Assets
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: production
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_production
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/1
        run: |
          bin/rails assets:precompile

      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: |
            public/assets/*
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
